recognize_zh: 低倍下在大量紅血球背景中有一團黏合的細胞群，核呈橢圓至細長、方向大致一致、分布均勻，細胞質淡而邊界不清，邊緣附著血小板，外觀溫和，是抽血帶入的內皮細胞團。
features: Single cohesive, loosely organized cell cluster among abundant red cells at low power
Oval to elongated nuclei with fairly uniform size and even spacing
Pale, indistinct cytoplasm forming a sheath-like syncytial sheet
Platelets adherent along and within the cluster
No marked pleomorphism, nuclear crowding, or molding appreciated at this magnification
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a single cohesive cluster of cells lying among abundant red cells. The cluster consists of evenly spaced oval to elongated nuclei within pale, poorly demarcated cytoplasm in a sheath-like arrangement, with adherent platelets. No significant nuclear pleomorphism, crowding, or molding is appreciated, although cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a cluster of endothelial cells, a benign venipuncture-related contaminant.

ddx.vs: Metastatic clusters show crowded, overlapping, pleomorphic nuclei with high N:C ratio and prominent nucleoli on high power.
Stromal fragments have more spindled nuclei in collagenous matrix, whereas endothelial sheets show oval nuclei in pale cytoplasm with adherent platelets.
Platelet clumps are granular purple masses with occasional lobulated leukocyte nuclei, not a sheet of uniform oval nuclei.
